title: Crunchy Bao Bites with Korean Basil
description: A tasty and crunchy Chinese-inspired snack made with bao, Korean chili flakes, and fresh basil.
instructions: 2. Cut the bao into bite-sized pieces.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the Korean chili flakes and bouncy rice vinegar.
4. Add the quick sesame oil to the bowl and stir to combine.
5. Add the chopped basil to the bowl and stir to combine.
6. Toss the bao pieces in the bowl to coat with the Korean chili flake mixture.
8. Spread the bao pieces on a baking sheet in a single layer.
9. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
